faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment is 14th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Senior Resident post is MD (Anaesthesia). Candidates must possess this degree to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Resident post announced by PGIMER in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the General category is a maximum of 40 years. For OBC candidates, it is a maximum of 43 years, and for SC/ST candidates, it is a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is age relaxation for reserved categories. OBC candidates get 3 years of relaxation, and SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation in the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident position at PGIMER will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it to the specified office.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview date for the Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview date for the Senior Resident recruitment is scheduled for 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article, which will direct you to the official PGIMER website.
